description: Comment (1)-A follow-up: full (Latitude/Longitude allowed as node features if SHAP selects them) vs no_coords (Latitude/Longitude excluded from the SHAP candidate pool -- freed slots go to the next-best mineral/lithology features, same 13-dim total) on Exp 1 (leave-one-region-out inductive), mode=full, SPIRE. Graph topology (spatial k-NN) is unchanged in both conditions -- this tests node-feature reliance only.
